reviews.exact_claim: For nonsingular ordinary column bases A,B and e=A_i in A minus B, det(A)det(B)=sum_j det(A^{ij})det(B^{ji}), summing B_j in B minus A. Thus source squared norm <= |B minus A| times output squared-norm sum. Barker exchanges P(X,Y)=mu(Y)/(d^2(mu(X)+mu(Y))) are reversible and acquire fixed-e local conductance >=mu(X)/(2d^3).
reviews.origin: c01_l02 INITIAL two-column Laplace route, sharpened to one-column inverse-matrix identity in revision1; standard determinant algebra, no novelty certification
reviews.baseline_overlap: Baseline already has determinant/hole Cauchy-Schwarz exchanges and split-register obstructions. Revision1 supplies an explicitly computable ordinary-basis mismatch proposal and local capacity bound; frozen c01_s01/s03 supply stronger refresh energy only on their admitted exact-count classes, not this unrestricted ordinary-basis proposal. Frozen c01_s02 delta^4 move obstruction is compatible: it excludes a designated paired move, not the sum of ordinary one-column mismatch terms.
reviews.independent_derivation: Let C=A^{-1}B. Replacement determinants are det(A)C_ij and det(B)(C^{-1})_ji. The sum C_ij(C^{-1})_ji=1; common columns vanish for e outside B. Activities cancel under conserved column multiset. Degree <=d^2 makes the Barker row stochastic, and detailed balance is exact. The Cauchy bound gives the stated local conductance by splitting outputs above/below source weight.
repairs_and_scope: The directed-cycle Hamming calculation is a valid endpoint identity ONLY in the complementary full-union component (odd,even)/(even,odd). It does not establish the all-additive energy gate for the actual four-state paired product law.

Choose h as occupancy of a labeled column, which equals its paired-line indicator on paired states. The sum h(A)+h(B) is conserved by every union-preserving exchange; (odd,odd) and (even,even) have different values in different union components. The complementary endpoints have equal additive sums. Thus the component interpolation is not the required global additive control.

Local capacity is not cut conductance, support connectivity, weighted congestion, or a Poincare theorem. The ordinary-basis normalizer is easy, but paired conditioning is exponentially rare on the cycle.

The new binary-matroid disconnected basis-pair preprint cited by the peer was not independently audited here; characteristic-two examples do not automatically apply over Q(i). No conclusion depends on that preprint.

reviews.independent_derivation: Cauchy-Binet gives Z_I. Projection P=A^*(AA^*)^{-1}A has principal-minor conditional law. Sequential choose j with P_jj/r, Schur update on remaining indices, and sum over ordered choices gives the exact unordered projection DPP. Independence-MH flow simplifies to the displayed symmetric expression. Since every Z_I<=c_k, it minorizes the independent-refresh flow by1/B. Stationarity and independence of replicas cancel cross increments for additive functions.
repairs_and_scope: Strengthen the bit argument: after conditioning on selected set S, the projection equals the original-kernel Schur complement P_RR-P_RS(P_SS)^{-1}P_SR. All entries are ratios of original minors, proving polynomial bit height without relying on the mere number of recursive rational updates.
B is polynomial at fixed k but exponential centrally; exact cycle gap2/B validates this limitation. Full joint-function tensorization needs the stated lazy version and2B; additive functions allow B.
The mismatch flag is an injective relabeling, not independent computational quantum state preparation. No general sampler or microscopic polynomial-energy theorem follows from pointwise tractability.

reviews.independent_derivation: Each selected original pair contributes one unit column and one f_i; every coordinate line contributes two unit columns. Hadamard bounds squared determinant by product selected ||f_i||^2. Overcount all coordinate-line subsets to get the binomial factor; sum original subsets with e_s. For epsilon<=1 drop epsilon^s to epsilon. Coordinate perfect matchings each weight1 give Z0=(r-1)!!. Exact elementary-symmetric DP acquires S_F and integer comparisons find K.
repairs_and_scope: Fixed-time non-dyadic exact fair coins are impossible. The peer's capped rejection construction correctly charges adaptive aborts; the entire run conditioned on nonabort is not generally exact when denominators depend on history. The peer explicitly preserves this distinction.

Uniform matching has a deterministic sequence of partner counts, so nonabort probability is independent of matching and conditional successful matching is exact. That special argument cannot be copied to adaptive MH paths.
Rational-activity ramp density/ratio bounds and telescoping sample costs are valid PROVIDED an acquired sampler exists at each tier; that condition remains the main open gate.

A polynomial-size one-deletion heatbath fiber CAN be normalized from direct determinants, as implemented in frozen c01_s02 revisions. Unknown partition objections apply to general large fibers, not every locally enumerable completion family.
